sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We highly value our long-standing cooperation and appreciate your willingness to commit to a 24-month contract.
To properly evaluate your proposed volume of 4,000 pieces per year, we kindly request the corresponding binding delivery schedules.
Building on your preferred terms of 30 days payment and a 24-month duration, we are pleased to revise our offer to €51.30 per unit.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
In recognition of your movement, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.40 for this package.
However, to properly evaluate your proposed volume of 4,000 pieces per year, we still require the corresponding binding delivery schedules.
Which volume can you commit to?
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We appreciate your continued steps towards us and are prepared to lower our price to €49.70 for the 45-day payment term. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stands at a price of €49.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

However, to fully evaluate the 4,000 pieces per year you mention, we still need to see the binding delivery schedules. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Our foundry has valued our shared history over the years, and we hope we can continue this partnership on sound terms for both our businesses.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
